description: This source file defines the ContentServicesComplex class, which provides complex service methods for handling content associations, including retrieval of related content and data resources based on various filtering criteria, for the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContentServicesComplex
classes.description: Provides service methods for managing and retrieving content associations and related resources in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResource
methods.description: Service method that retrieves related content and data resource views based on various filters such as association types, content types, date ranges, and direction.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Core method that performs the construction of entity conditions, executes the query, and returns associated content/resource views.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCache
methods.description: Service method that retrieves related content/data resource views with enhanced filtering, including cache support and additional predicate filtering.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCacheMethod
methods.description: Internal method that builds complex entity conditions, performs data retrieval with optional ordering, and assembles the result set, supporting caching.
